id: 10_Laboratory Safety Designing Safe Labs and Preventing Electrical Hazards Training
title: 实验室安全：安全设计与电气危害预防
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/10_Laboratory Safety Designing Safe Labs and Preventing Electrical Hazards Training.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/10_Laboratory Safety Designing Safe Labs and Preventing Electrical Hazards Training/src.py

points.K1: 好的电气设计护楼也护人
points.K12: 不间断电源：扛住短时停电
points.K13: 备用发电机：保关键系统
points.K22: 防护用品勤检查、干燥放

shots.scene: 欣欣站在新装修的实验室里，墙上有整齐的插座和配电箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a newly built lab with neat wall outlets and a closed electrical panel, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：从设计开始防电气危害。
overlay: 从设计开始防电气危害

shots.scene: 图纸、插座、断路器、挂锁、绝缘手套五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a blueprint, a wall outlet, a circuit breaker, a padlock and an insulating glove. No people.
shots.narration: 布局、保护、安装、上锁、防护。

shots.scene: 老周和老李在新实验室里看空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer look at a blank floor plan in an empty new lab.
shots.narration: 老周的新实验室要装修，先找老李看图。

shots.scene: 图纸上水池旁画着插座，老李指着
shots.prompt_en: On the blank floor plan, an outlet icon sits right next to a sink icon; the facility engineer points at it.
shots.narration: 老李说：电气设计，得从头想清楚。

shots.section_title: 好的电气设计护楼也护人
shots.scene: 实验楼图标和人形图标被同一面盾牌罩住
shots.prompt_en: A lab building icon and a person icon both covered by one large shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 结构合理的电气设计，护楼也护人。
overlay: 好的电气设计护楼也护人

shots.section_title: 好的电气设计护楼也护人
shots.scene: 老李用笔在图纸上标出电路走向
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer draws circuit lines on a blank floor plan with a pencil.
shots.narration: 设计时要兼顾安全和功能。

shots.scene: 配电箱里每个开关下都贴着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: An open electrical panel where every breaker has a blank label beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 一是标识清楚：回路和配电箱都标好。

shots.scene: 负荷被均分到三个回路的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of several appliance icons evenly split across three circuit lines, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 二是负荷均衡，防止过热和故障。

shots.scene: 实验台上方一排插座，设备就近插电
shots.prompt_en: A row of outlets mounted above a lab bench; each instrument plugs in nearby with short cords. No people.
shots.narration: 三是插座开关放得顺手，少拉线。

shots.scene: 短路火花、发热、触电三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out: a short-circuit spark, an overheating wire and an electric shock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 这样能减少短路、过热和意外触电。

shots.scene: 配电箱前通道宽敞，老李伸手打开箱门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer easily opens a wall electrical panel with a clear open space in front of it.
shots.narration: 配电箱和控制装置，维修应急要够得着。

shots.scene: 设备外壳的接地线连到接地符号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an instrument casing with a green-yellow wire running to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电气系统要正确接地。

shots.scene: 故障电流沿接地线流走，人形图标安全打勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of fault current flowing down the ground wire instead of through a person icon, which has a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 出故障时，电流有安全的入地通路。

shots.scene: 几个金属设备外壳用线连成一体
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of several metal equipment frames connected together by bonding wires to one bar. No people.
shots.narration: 等电位联结：所有金属部件电位一致。

shots.scene: 熔断器图标，电流超过时熔丝断开
shots.prompt_en: A fuse icon whose thin wire melts and breaks when a current arrow grows too large. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器：电流超过安全值，就熔断。

shots.scene: 断路器手柄自动跳下
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker icon whose handle flips down automatically, with overload and short-circuit icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断路器：过载或短路，自动断电。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器图标，检测到电流不平衡就断开
shots.prompt_en: A ground fault circuit interrupter icon with a balance scale tipping, then the switch opening. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器：电流不平衡，立即断电。

shots.scene: 水池旁的插座带漏电保护
shots.prompt_en: A wall outlet with test and reset buttons installed beside a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 水槽、水盆旁，必须用漏电保护插座。

shots.scene: 老李对照空白说明书安装仪器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a lab instrument while reading a blank manufacturer manual.
shots.narration: 正确安装设备，才是根本的防护。

shots.scene: 合格电工图标和插头对插座的匹配示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a qualified electrician with a blank certificate, and a plug matching a socket with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看说明书，找合格人员，核对供电匹配。

shots.scene: 配电箱开关标签与实验室插座编号对应
shots.prompt_en: Blank labels on breakers in a panel connected by dotted lines to matching blank tags on lab outlets. No people.
shots.narration: 回路贴好标签，维修排查更高效。

shots.scene: 老李按标签拉下对应开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the matching labeled breaker.
shots.narration: 少碰带电线，维修时断对回路。

shots.section_title: 不间断电源：扛住短时停电
shots.scene: 实验室灯灭，仪器旁的不间断电源指示灯亮
shots.prompt_en: Lab lights go out during a power cut while a small uninterruptible power supply box keeps an instrument screen on. No people.
shots.narration: 突然停电，不间断电源马上供电。
overlay: 不间断电源：扛住短时停电

shots.section_title: 不间断电源：扛住短时停电
shots.scene: 精密仪器图标被盾牌保护
shots.prompt_en: A sensitive instrument icon protected by a shield with a battery symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 保护精密仪器，不因短时停电受损。

shots.section_title: 备用发电机：保关键系统
shots.scene: 楼外的备用发电机开始运转
shots.prompt_en: A backup generator unit outside a lab building starts running, with a power line to the building. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间停电，靠备用发电机。
overlay: 备用发电机：保关键系统

shots.section_title: 备用发电机：保关键系统
shots.scene: 冰箱、通风柜、报警器图标亮着
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab freezer, a fume hood and an alarm panel still glowing with power. No people.
shots.narration: 保证关键系统持续运行。

shots.scene: 阿杰想打开仪器后盖，被小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches to open the back panel of an instrument; the female graduate student stops him.
shots.narration: 电气活不该由实验人员来干。

shots.scene: 老李在断开的开关上挂锁和空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a red padlock and a blank danger tag to an isolator.
shots.narration: 维修保养时上锁挂牌，防止意外启动。

shots.scene: 老李告诉小研和阿杰要停机维修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tells the female graduate student and the young male student that the machine will be serviced.
shots.narration: 第一步，通知受影响的人员。

shots.scene: 隔离开关上挂锁和挂牌
shots.prompt_en: A padlock and a blank tag attached to the isolating switch handle. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，用指定的锁或牌锁住隔离装置。

shots.scene: 拉下隔离开关、关闭阀门
shots.prompt_en: A hand pulls down an isolating switch and turns a valve closed. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，断开能源：开关、阀门、断路器。

shots.scene: 按停止键停机
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses the stop button on an instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，按正常程序停机。

shots.scene: 老李用验电笔确认无电，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the instrument with a voltage tester and a green check appears.
shots.narration: 第五步，确认设备已经和能源断开。

shots.scene: 触电、电弧、灼伤三个图标旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric shock, an arc flash and a burn, each blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 正确使用防护装备，大大降低伤害风险。

shots.scene: 面罩、眼镜、头罩、手套、鞋五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a face shield, safety glasses, a hood, insulating gloves and leather boots. No people.
shots.narration: 面罩、护目镜、头罩、绝缘手套、绝缘鞋。

shots.scene: 老李戴上透明防电弧面罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a clear arc-rated face shield attached to a hard hat.
shots.narration: 面罩：防电弧、熔融金属和飞溅碎片。

shots.scene: 面罩上贴着空白评级标签
shots.prompt_en: A face shield with a blank rating tag and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 雇主要选按行业标准评定防电弧的面罩。

shots.scene: 不导电护目镜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of safety glasses with non-metal frames and clear lenses. No people.
shots.narration: 不导电护目镜：防电气、飞屑和化学品溅。

shots.scene: 护目镜挡住飞来的颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Safety glasses blocking flying particles with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 镜框镜片不导电，还要耐冲击。

shots.scene: 防电弧头罩挂在架子上
shots.prompt_en: An arc-rated protective hood hanging on a rack, covering head, neck and shoulders shape. No people.
shots.narration: 防电弧头罩，护住头、颈和肩。

shots.scene: 头罩评级刻度不低于暴露水平
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon showing a hood rating bar at or above an exposure level line. No people.
shots.narration: 防护等级不低于预期的暴露水平。

shots.scene: 绝缘手套与电压等级图标
shots.prompt_en: A pair of rubber insulating gloves next to a lightning bolt icon with a blank rating tag. No people.
shots.narration: 带电作业戴绝缘手套，护住手和手臂。

shots.scene: 手套等级与作业电压匹配打勾
shots.prompt_en: A glove rating tag matched to a voltage icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 额定电压要和作业电压相符。

shots.scene: 老李穿上电绝缘皮鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on electrical-hazard rated leather safety boots.
shots.narration: 电绝缘皮鞋防触电，选经过认证的。

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤检查、干燥放
shots.scene: 老李检查手套，对着光看有无裂口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a rubber insulating glove against the light for cracks.
shots.narration: 定期检查有无裂纹、划痕和损坏。
overlay: 防护用品勤检查、干燥放

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤检查、干燥放
shots.scene: 防护用品整齐放在干燥柜里
shots.prompt_en: Insulating gloves, a face shield and boots stored neatly in a clean dry cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 不用时，清洁干燥存放。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现标签、天平、插座图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a label, a balance scale and a wall outlet.
shots.narration: 标识清楚、负荷均衡、布置合理。

shots.scene: 接地、熔断器、断路器、漏电保护四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a ground symbol, a fuse, a circuit breaker and a ground fault interrupter. No people.
shots.narration: 接地联结，层层保护，水边防漏电。

shots.scene: 挂锁和绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a padlock with a tag and an insulating glove. No people.
shots.narration: 维修上锁挂牌，作业穿戴防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的配电箱旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a closed, clearly labeled electrical panel.
shots.narration: 用电有章法，实验才安心，下次见！
